name: DevHound Secret Check (local)
description: Scan selected text or a page for hardcoded secrets, entirely offline. No network, no tracking.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
